sourceOfTruth: main + green PR evidence + current playtest feedback

initiative.goal: Regiments march, manoeuvre, use/leave roads, pass friendlies, deploy on enemy contact, engage and reform as coherent military formations.

authorityContract.gameplayAi: intent/state only: march -> approach -> deploy -> engage -> disengage/reform; targets, engagement distance, unit-role decisions
authorityContract.movementSimulation: physical execution only: route/corridor, speed, acceleration/deceleration, facing/turning, formation anchors/slots, traffic/collision, regrouping
authorityContract.graphicsMobileUx: readability/diagnostics only; never a second movement or combat authority

roadmapStages.name: deterministic baseline
roadmapStages.exit: same-seed movement-contact replay exposes reproducible failures and metrics

roadmapStages.name: formation-first movement
roadmapStages.exit: regiment anchor/slots dominate motion; members correct locally without swarm/rubber-band behavior

roadmapStages.name: look-ahead steering
roadmapStages.exit: road/open-terrain turns are anticipated without waypoint zigzag, snap-turning or stop-start cadence

roadmapStages.name: friendly traffic
roadmapStages.exit: regiments pass, merge onto roads and queue at constrained corridors without persistent overlap/deadlock

roadmapStages.name: contact envelope
roadmapStages.exit: awareness/approach/deploy/engage distances produce controlled slowdown, facing and frontage before attack

roadmapStages.name: role-specific momentum
roadmapStages.exit: infantry, cavalry and artillery have distinct credible acceleration/turn/contact behavior without instant snaps

roadmapStages.name: predictive order preview
roadmapStages.exit: player can read intended route, destination frontage/facing and obvious conflicts before execution on desktop/mobile

roadmapStages.name: battle choreography
roadmapStages.exit: multi-regiment groups coordinate frontage, reserves, flanks and artillery without collapsing into one target point

coreScenarios: open-terrain diagonal march plus large turn

health.ci: main run 729 green after PR #126; PR #127 run 730 was green before movement-contact refresh; newest refresh requires fresh CI
health.gameplay: player playtest identifies movement-to-contact feel as the current highest product gap
health.movement: bridge/chokepoint baseline remains 20/20 complete, 0 failures, 0 hard stalls, max observed stall 2.5s; general road/off-road formation flow needs improvement
health.aiCombat: deterministic combat coverage is green, but approach-to-contact/deploy/engage behavior needs player-visible improvement
health.graphicsUxMobile: shared Pointer Events mobile authority is green; visual work is supporting/diagnostic while movement-contact is priority
health.performance: core Golden draw p95 41.31ms vs update p95 12.41ms remains important but is temporarily below the movement-contact gameplay gap
